title: A high surface area silica-supported aldehyde as a flow-compatible amine scavenger
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30916-30927
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA04582K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
A. Michelle Reinhardt, Jenny-Lee Panayides, Darren L. Riley
A silica-supported aldehyde scavenger (SSA-3) was prepared from SBA-15 silica by sequential NaOH activation, alkylation with 1,2-dichloroethane, and Kornblum oxidation of the resulting alkyl chloride in DMSO/K2CO3.
